method: three evidence tiers, no invented numbers: recorded full-dataset outcomes + a registered-policy baseline counterfactual; a live re-simulation of the same cohort by the current engine via the existing policy-simulator API; and the existing reproducible Stage 11 sandbox benchmark

cohort.definition: all recovery_cases.csv rows = the recovery-eligible cohort of the 10,506-transaction seed-42 synthetic year (recovery records exist only for transactions with a non-NONE anomaly and a non-STALLED final state)
cohort.recoverable_definition: recovery_candidate=true AND anomaly_type=GENUINE_FAILURE in the recorded risk_assessments — exactly the registered manual-only-baseline policy's manual-review queue

A_full_dataset_recorded.ground_truth_source: recovery_cases.recovery_required + risk_assessments.anomaly_type / recovery_candidate, written by generate_full_dataset.py from the simulated TRUE outcome, independent of any policy decision

baseline_counterfactual.definition: registered manual-only-baseline semantics (api/services/policy_simulator.py) applied to the recorded assessments: never releases; every recoverable case -> MANUAL_REVIEW; everything else NO_ACTION

customer_proxy.label: PROXY — customer impact measured as queue/waiting burden, not a surveyed customer outcome

B_full_dataset_live_simulation.note: the CURRENT engine's DECISION layer re-decided every recorded case on the same evidence via the existing policy-simulator API (read-only simulation); ground truth for false/missed comes from the recorded dataset labels, never from the engine under test; value metrics are reported both at the decision layer and execution-consistent (amounts above the configured auto-release cap of 1500 BDT are rejected by recovery_policy.evaluate_policy at execution and are excluded from the execution-consistent figure)
B_full_dataset_live_simulation.genuine_denominator_definition: recorded risk_assessments anomaly_type == GENUINE_FAILURE (independent ground truth)

false_recovery_detail.note: cross-transaction duplicate evidence is not visible to per-transaction simulation; recorded chain handled it safely (blocked)

cohort.definition: deterministic demo corpus DEMO-S1..S6 (Stage 11 Phase 11H, ground truth available)

limitations: 100% synthetic data (manifest: synthetic=true, seed 42); no real payments, persons, or amounts.
Evidence A records the v1 system's outcomes as generated on 2026-10-03; the baseline arm is a counterfactual derived from the REGISTERED baseline policy semantics, not a separately executed run.
Evidence B re-decides recorded cases with today's engine at evaluation time; fresh-evidence gates see evaluation-time clocks.
Evidence C is a 6-transaction deterministic benchmark — it is NOT the full dataset and must never be presented as such.
No extrapolation, annualization, or per-year projection is made anywhere in this evaluation.
Customer impact is a PROXY (queue/waiting burden), not a surveyed customer outcome.
